item.title: Brazen daytime robbery at Lynden Park Mall jewelry store in Brantford
item.description: A brazen daytime robbery took place Monday afternoon at a Brantford shopping mall. Four masked suspects entered the Charm Diamonds store in the Lynden Park Mall where they smashed glass showcases and made off with a quantity of jewelry.
